lines: Welcome, the worst player of the hub, {name}. Why do you still play?
{name}, your aim has left the chat. Permanently.
Loading {name}'s stats... error: no skill found.
{name} whiffed so hard, the wind apologized.
Radiant lobby called, {name}. They said stay away.
{name}, even the bots feel bad for you.
{name}'s crosshair placement: somewhere in another game.
Coach says {name} should try chess instead.
{name}, that ping was faster than your reaction time.
Breaking news: {name} missed a point blank spray again.
{name}, your KD is a cry for help.
The enemy team thanks {name} for the free rounds.
{name} bought a rifle and forgot how guns work.
Somewhere, a Silver rank is crying because {name} exists.
